column3: NKJV has “we circled round,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “we cast off” (weighed anchor).
NKJV includes “the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “our fathers,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “your fathers.”
This verse is absent from the critical text; NKJV includes it following the Textus Receptus (the Jews departed disputing among themselves).
